profile.name: VDI PM5B功率计
profile.description: 用于与 VDI PM5B 功率计通信，获取功率读数，并解析量程、状态与固件版本信息，适合实验中的射频或微波功率测量。
profile.description_en: Communicates with the VDI PM5B power meter to obtain power readings and parse range, status, and firmware version information for RF or microwave power measurements in laboratory experiments.
